fields.reasoning: The change set's intent is to stop runs stalling on Claude Code permission prompts, which blocks the daemon shipping the backlog unattended; recent run-reliability fixes (#259, #267) serve milestone-25 for the same reason. The guides (internal/guide/text/build.md:78, review.md:37 and :50, plan-review.md:33 and :45) show `<file>` for both findings and verdict, and verdict is written the same way findings are, so leaving it would keep the same prompt-triggering pattern; switching both is the whole fix. readReviewFile (internal/api/run_review.go:276) already reads `-` as stdin and run-review-journal.txtar exercises it, so the only change and the only new test surface is the guide text, which internal/guide's existing tests already pin by substring.
fields.statement: Change set 01M6MM3 serves milestone-25 (the daemon builds and ships the backlog on its own). Every place the build, review and plan-review guides show `rhiza run findings ... <file>` or `rhiza run verdict ... <file>` switches to the stdin heredoc form (e.g. `rhiza run findings --check "$RHIZA_CHECK" - <<'EOF'` ... `EOF`), keeping the existing flags (--leaf, --check, --json) and JSON shapes; no temp file or compound shell is shown anywhere. No CLI change: both commands already accept `-`. Test it in internal/guide: update build_test.go, review_test.go and plan_test.go to assert the `- <<'EOF'` form for findings and verdict and that no `<file>` form for either command remains in the three guides; run `go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/...`. Stdin reading itself is already covered by run-review-journal.txtar.
